mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_rubric (rubric_id, name, eval_type, version, dimensions, enabled, builtin, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{rubricId}, #{name}, #{evalType}, #{version}, #{dimensions}, #{enabled}, #{builtin}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, rubric_id, name, eval_type, version, dimensions, enabled, builtin, create_time, update_time FROM eval_rubric WHERE rubric_id = #{rubricId}
SELECT id, rubric_id, name, eval_type, version, dimensions, enabled, builtin, create_time, update_time FROM eval_rubric WHERE name = #{name}

SELECT id, rubric_id, name, eval_type, version, dimensions, enabled, builtin, create_time, update_time FROM eval_rubric WHERE eval_type = #{evalType} AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY builtin ASC, version DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, rubric_id, name, eval_type, version, dimensions, enabled, builtin, create_time, update_time FROM eval_rubric ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
